company.name: Alibaba / Qwen
company.tagline: Championing versatile Apache-2.0 open-weight model portfolios from edge sizes to high-end clouds.
company.overview: Alibaba Cloud develops the Qwen model family, China's most popular open-weights AI ecosystem. Spanning from tiny edge models to massive cloud-based Mixture-of-Experts, Qwen supports Apache-2.0 licensing, offering high-end reasoning, visual understanding, and developer frameworks for global AI deployments.

llms.name: Qwen3.7 Max (Proprietary)
llms.short_tagline: Flagship closed model scoring top on Chinese BenchLM tests.
llms.description: Qwen3.7 Max is Alibaba's top-end closed-weights model family. Accessed via DashScope cloud endpoints, it delivers premier performance on complex logical analysis, Chinese linguistic structures, and high-concurrency enterprise reasoning tasks.

llms.name: Qwen3.5 Reasoning (Open-Weight)
llms.short_tagline: 397B parameters reasoning model for self-hosted compute.
llms.description: Qwen3.5 Reasoning represents Alibaba's frontier open-weight reasoning model. Utilizing a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) configuration with 397 billion parameters, it is engineered for on-premise high-end coding, mathematical calculations, and autonomous agent coordination.

llms.name: Qwen2.5-72B (Open-Source)
llms.short_tagline: Highly popular open weights model for general tasks.
llms.description: Qwen2.5-72B is a widely-used open weights model comparable to Llama-3.1-70B. It excels at multi-turn dialogue, general knowledge retrieval, and coding support, serving as a robust foundation for building cost-effective local agents.

llms.name: Qwen Coder / Qwen-VL
llms.short_tagline: Domain-specific coding and vision-language model checkpoints.
llms.description: The Qwen Specialized collection includes Qwen-Coder (engineered for multi-language code synthesis) and Qwen-VL (engineered for visual-language reasoning). These models offer compact parameter sizes optimized for edge servers and mobile apps.

platforms.name: Alibaba DashScope Portal
platforms.short_tagline: Unified cloud API endpoint managing Qwen deployments.
platforms.description: DashScope is Alibaba Cloud's model service platform. It provides developers with secure, high-concurrency API access to Qwen flagship models, offering built-in data protection, logging monitors, and custom fine-tuning runtimes.

platforms.name: Alibaba ModelScope Hub
platforms.description: ModelScope is Alibaba's open-source machine learning hub. It hosts thousands of community models and datasets, providing Git-based workflows and pre-configured cloud containers for rapid model evaluation.

learning.name: Qwen Deployment Guides
learning.short_tagline: Step-by-step instructions for local serving and fine-tuning.
learning.description: Technical guides detailing how to serve Qwen models using vLLM, configure LoRA adapters, run quantization pipelines, and deploy models on consumer hardware.

technologies.name: Qwen Agent Framework
technologies.short_tagline: Open-source toolkit for building LLM agents.
technologies.description: A Python-based framework developed by Alibaba for building agents with tool calling, memory management, and multi-agent planning. It is optimized to utilize Qwen models' native function-calling capabilities.
